summary.text: Kevin Van Diepen is a Republican state representative from District 22 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Van Diepen assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 14, 2025, and serves on the House Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and the House Local Government Committee.
